summary: A live mailbox stream handles each change in a fixed number of statements, whatever the size of the open mailbox

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes; the stream keeps sort keys only in memory.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No claim rule or coordination change. The rollout intake hold and canonical message order are the same; the hold is read once per update and order keys are reused between updates.

compatibility.detail: Mailbox frames, their order and delivery policy are unchanged; native drivers see the same stream.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; streams reconnect normally across the daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; a reconnecting stream rebuilds its in-memory keys from a full read.
